hints.title: Read the circle geometry
hints.body: The centres are (−2,1) and (4,1), six units apart, and both radii are 3. A radius to a tangent point is perpendicular to the tangent.
hints.recap: The line of centres is horizontal.
hints.pause: Sketch both centres and the increasing common tangent.

recall.reminder: Read centre coordinates with the opposite signs from the completed-square brackets.

hints.title: Use the midpoint
hints.body: For equal radii, the sloping common tangent passes through the midpoint (1,1) of the centres. The triangle from this midpoint to either centre and its tangent point has hypotenuse 3 and one perpendicular side 3.
hints.recap: The required angle is between the tangent and the horizontal line of centres.
hints.pitfall: The horizontal common tangents have zero gradient and are excluded.
hints.pause: Find the other side of the right triangle.

recall.reminder: A common internal tangent and the two radii give similar right triangles; equal radii place the crossing at the centres’ midpoint.

hints.title: Use the correct trigonometric ratio
hints.body: Use Pythagoras in the triangle from the centres’ midpoint to the centre and tangent point. Then identify which sides are opposite and adjacent to the angle with the horizontal.
hints.pitfall: Using radius over hypotenuse would find <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mi>θ</mi></mrow></math> instead.
hints.pause: Calculate the tangent ratio and simplify its surd form.

recall.reminder: For an internal common tangent of equal circles, build the right triangle using the radius and midpoint of the centres.

solution:
The centres are C1=(−2,1), C2=(4,1), each with radius 3. Their separation is 6. The nonhorizontal common tangents cross the line of centres at its midpoint M=(1,1), since the perpendicular distances to the two centres are equal.

For the positive-gradient tangent, take a tangent point T. Triangle MC1T is right-angled at T, with MC1=3 and C1T=3. Thus MT=9−3=6. The acute angle between the tangent and the horizontal has tanθ=36=12=22.

Answer C: 22.
